mechanism_narrative: The four-week upward trend in RETAIL_REC itself reflects reopening momentum: each weekly mean is less negative than the prior one, so the same adaptation continues and the next 28-day mean is higher than the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rises from -66.4 to -57.6 across four weeks
failure_condition: If the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to the last 28-day mean, the self-momentum claim is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility crosses above -45, outdoor recreation absorbs discretionary trips that would otherwise go to retail and recreation venues, so RETAIL_REC next two weeks falls relative to the prior two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean exceeds -45 or rises by more than 10 percentage points week-on-week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumps from -51.4 to -37.3 in the final week
failure_condition: If PARKS exceeds -45 and the next 14-day mean of RETAIL_REC is greater than or equal to the prior 14-day mean, the substitution hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Retail recovery is interaction-driven: when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve week-on-week, commuter and office footfall jointly create incidental retail trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES each improve by at least 3 percentage points week-on-week.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rises from -59.1 to -54.1 and WORKPLACES from -53.3 to -49.7
failure_condition: If the joint improvement condition occurs and the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to the last 28-day mean, the interaction hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a work-from-home-elevated regime where RESIDENTIAL remains above 14 percent above baseline, fewer commutes and office hours suppress incidental retail trips, so RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks is lower than the last four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean remains above 14 for two consecutive weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 14.9 at t-0w and was above 15 in preceding weeks
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays above 14 for two consecutive weeks and the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is greater than or equal to the last 28-day mean, the regime hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A spring seasonal shift raises essential shopping first: once GROCERY_PHARM crosses above -30, restored grocery and pharmacy routines spill over into adjacent retail and recreation trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rises from -35.1 to -25.6 across four weeks
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM is above -30 and the next 14-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to the prior 14-day mean, the spillover hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A joint substitution effect is active when PARKS rises sharply while RESIDENTIAL falls: households shift from home and indoor retail toward outdoor leisure, so RETAIL_REC over the next week is lower than the prior week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by at least 10 percentage points week-on-week and RESIDENTIAL falls by at least 1 percentage point week-on-week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rises 14.1 points and RESIDENTIAL falls 1.1 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: If the joint condition occurs and RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is greater than or equal to the prior 7-day mean, the substitution hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT recovery only accelerates retail once transit station mobility crosses above -55: below that threshold mobility remains too suppressed for shopping trips, but above it retail footfall follows, so RETAIL_REC next two weeks is higher.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rises from -55.9 at t-1w to -54.1 at t-0w, crossing -55
failure_condition: If TRANSIT is above -55 and the next 14-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to the prior 14-day mean, the threshold hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An office-return policy effect is interaction-driven: when WORKPLACES crosses above -50 while RESIDENTIAL stays below 15, commuter and after-work retail trips jointly lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean is above -50 and RESIDENTIAL weekly mean is below 15.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is -49.7 and RESIDENTIAL is 14.9 at t-0w
regime_hint: office return with reduced at-home time
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES is above -50 and RESIDENTIAL is below 15, but the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to the last 28-day mean, the office-return interaction hypothesis is rejected.
